read.thesis: Middle East outage takes 6 Mt (20–25% of regional PE supply) offline until at least 2027, with China inventories down ~30%, supporting elevated margins; EBITDA $2.1bn, 23% margin in Q2.

utilisation.quote: Our second quarter operating rates for the segment was approximately 90% with our crackers operating at approximately 95% during the quarter.

capex.quote: We continue to maintain our 2026 CapEx plan of $1.2 billion and expect sustaining CapEx to decrease by approximately $100 million following the divestiture of 4 European assets.

triggers.label: 6 Mt Middle East PE offline to 2027
triggers.quote: we estimate approximately 6 million tons of polyethylene capacity or around 20% to 25% of Middle East supply sustained damage from the conflict and will not restart until at least 2027.
triggers.highlight: will not restart until at least 2027

triggers.label: China PE inventories down ~30%
triggers.quote: we have seen Chinese polyethylene inventories declined by roughly 30% versus pre-conflict levels as local operating rates remain in the mid-70% range.
triggers.highlight: declined by roughly 30% versus pre-conflict levels

triggers.label: Aug PE price +$0.10/lb announced
triggers.quote: we have announced a $0.10 per pound price increase for polyethylene in August.

triggers.label: June PE contract -$0.15/lb after April +$0.30
triggers.quote: June contract prices settled $0.15 per pound lower, but for the year, polyethylene pricing remained shorter than 2025.
triggers.highlight: June contract prices settled $0.15 per pound lower

triggers.label: Q2 domestic PE sales +3.5%
triggers.quote: domestic sales volumes up approximately 3.5% and marking the highest domestic sales quarter since the first quarter 2022.
triggers.highlight: highest domestic sales quarter since the first quarter 2022

triggers.label: Q3 O&P Americas rates ~85%
triggers.quote: the third quarter operating rates across the segment are projected to be approximately 85% of nameplate capacity.

triggers.label: Working capital build in Q2
triggers.quote: higher prices and operating rates drove an intentional build of working capital in the second quarter.

guidance.quote: We continue to maintain our 2026 CapEx plan of $1.2 billion

red_flags.quote: higher prices and operating rates drove an intentional build of working capital in the second quarter.

red_flags.label: Bayport PO/TBA outage ~$250m EBITDA hit; acetyls reliability issues at La Porte
red_flags.quote: we continue to experience reliability issues in our syngas unit which is affecting our -- both of our acid production and our VAM production at our La Porte site.

evasions.quote: there's a lot of factors that say that there's the potential for price settlement to be flat and potentially move up throughout the quarter.
